newsitem.title: JAPAN: TABLE- Japan June industrial output falls 3.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE- Japan June industrial output falls 3.1 pct.

text.p: Japan's industrial production in June fell a preliminary 3.1 percent from the previous month on a seasonally adjusted basis, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Wednesday.
MITI said in a statement that output was on a gradual rising trend.
It forecast manufacturers' output would rise month-on-month by 1.3 percent in July but would fall 0.5 percent in August.
Data for the April-June quarter showed output was unchanged from the previous quarter but had increased 6.8 percent from the same period a year earlier.
